<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Remove the Ladder Once the Enemy Has Ascended to the Roof</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
Liu Qi (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">刘琦</span></span>,
died 209 A.D.) of Eastern Han once turned to Zhuge Liang for advice
concerning self-preservation, but Zhuge Liang refused to help him. On
a later occasion, while visiting a garden, Liu Qi persuaded Zhuge to
join him in climbing a nearby tower. In the tower, while visiting and
feasting, Liu Qi secretly instructed his servants to remove the very
ladder by which they ascended. He then told Zhuge Liang, "Now,
nothing goes up to Heaven and nothing goes down to Earth. Whatever
you say will be heard by me only. Can't you say something now?"
Zhuge Liang replied, "Sir, haven't you read that Shensheng was
in danger because he remained in Jin while Chong'er was safe because
he was outside Jin?" Liu Qi understood what Zhuge Liang was
alluding to, and secretly came up with an idea [7].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Remove
the Ladder Once the Enemy Has Ascended to the Roof</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the 21st hexagram, <i>Fire
over Thunder</i>. The
yang line in the fourth position (from the bottom) is viewed as
having moved there from below, now isolated with no line of retreat
[1], [28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"></span>


</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">

LIST 28:</b></span></span></span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section80" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我没有收到他的工作计划表。</span></span></span></p>

	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I have not received

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">

	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">3)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">好多艺术家喜欢在那个小店买油漆和刷</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;子。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我已经向杂志提交了那篇论文。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5)<span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">这里房屋的样子和我老家的不一样。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">6)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">他把书下面的纸抽走了。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">注册以后，他们会给你活动安排表。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在医院，先挂号再看医生。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">有时，去银行取号以后要等很长时间。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这束光太亮了，要戴太阳眼镜。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">化学家和生物学家是两种科学家。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12)   <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">陀思妥耶夫斯基是我最喜欢的作者。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13)<span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">我可以借用你的梯子吗？</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	14)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不要在这里的草上躺着，衣服都要被弄</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;湿了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	15) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">今天很热，你应该穿薄的衣服，这件太</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;厚了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-target-text9"></a></span>
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">1</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">6</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)
	<span style="font-family: times;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">她对我说：</span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">“我</span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">习惯</span></span><span lang="zh-CN">剪</span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="font-family: times;">细的头发，你的头</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;发很粗，所以有一点难剪。</span>”</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	17) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他是一名科学家，也是一名作家。</span></span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
-------------------------------------</span></p>
